text: Cuddalore Bus Crash: 9 Killed, Multiple Injured; Tamil Nadu CM Announces Compensation For VictimsIn a tragic accident in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu, nine people were killed and several others were injured when a government bus collided with two cars following a tyre burst.
